feat(hepta-agentd): add evaluated original-task reads for Selector

Keep the legacy TrainingNoUpdate profile strict. Add a separately bound four/five-cut readonly profile from actual opaque T/B and S receipts, and consume its real Source/Cell readback in the original remote Selector journal/signature path. Preserve live T/B readback, cancellation, original transport bounds and cold read-only behavior.

Add six mechanism cases and exact caller/source closure. Actual isolated Rust 1.96 formatting and 82 scoped source/mutation checks pass. These new native cases are unrun. The three-case native diagnostic runs separately on 4ab34bb; its result is not a validation of this source. Candidate/Root/Version dispatch and ordinary qualifications remain gated.
